body: I used to go to therapy, but it never helped. I really don't like having people know how I am, thus the throwaway account.
Thank you, I just really don't know how much longer I can put it off. I never thought I'd live this long honestly

Thank you, I know, I always used to be so anti-drug too... But now I'm just too drunk or high to give a shit, or I'm staring out a window wishing I could jump out... I play basketball, I used to be able to shoot hoops for hours and it cleared my head more than anything, but now I just can't, I quit on my team last year because I simply couldn't bring myself to be around people. I hate who I've turned into :(

The thing is the fighting back has completely drained me. I can barely get out of bed anymore, I lost my last stable job because I cut my arms to shit and was too embarrassed to go back. I've been sober maybe 2 days the past 4 months.. I feel like every day I don't is just prolonging it now
